detail.longDescription: As a fun project this weekend I baked a tiny language model into an SVG, and made it so you can run it in a browser. The whole thing is in a single SVG. The model, it uh, doesn't work that well, but I think with some iteration this might have some use. https:// robrohan.com/2026/10/17/llm-in -an-svg.html # ai # llm # machinelearning # software # coding
